Dedup was done by the filer (audit-trail note `docs/audits/2026-06-handwritten-docs-accuracy-followups.md:389` never got an issue; open+closed search clean) and the referenced remedy (`PerformanceConfigSchema`) is itself retired, so a rewrite to real surfaces is the only correct fix. Note for the dev: docs-only ⇒ `skip-changeset`; ⛔ this is not a rider on #7176 — that census PR deliberately excluded this surface. Size/model suggestion: S–M, subagent, sonnet.

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine。

## ACCEPT — PR #8301 (round 1, `domain:devx` seat)

⚠️ **Accepted under the direct-review fallback: this dev never filed a report.** Its container was restarted mid-task and the agent was killed. Per the seat's rule that a lost report is not a stalled acceptance, the PR was reviewed on its own merits against `origin/main` — and because the dev died *between* its last commit and any report, **the PR body is stale and the shipped diff is what I reviewed.**

### The body and the shipped text contradict each other — the shipped text is the correct one

The PR body (written at the first commit) says the replacement points authors at *"the one real, consumed switch — the boolean `virtualScroll` on a list-shaped view"*, with four objectui `file:line` citations. **That claim is false**, and the dev appears to have caught it itself: its second commit, `c55cd817` *"align the Layout DSL performance note with the #7176 view-level retirement"*, rewrote exactly that passage. It died before updating the body.

Verified on `origin/main`, which side is true:

- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/retired-keys/17.ui__ListView__virtualScroll.ts` and the `ObjectListView` twin both exist — the key is **retired**, not live.
- `conversions/registry.ts:2282` states it verbatim: *"view list keys removed (#7176): 'striped'/'bordered'/'virtualScroll' — every measured reader copied the key forward and none applied it (pass-through-only; ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove)"*.
- `virtualScroll` has **0** exact-key hits across all 1049 entries of `packages/spec/authorable-surface/ui.json`.

⇒ Had the first version shipped, the page would have redirected authors from one phantom key to **another key retired in the same major** — teaching a second wrong thing, which is the one outcome the dispatch order explicitly forbade. The self-correction is the most valuable thing in this delivery.

### What I verified in the shipped text

Every load-bearing claim in the new `## Performance` section checks out on `origin/main`:

| claim | reading |
|---|---|
| `FormSectionSchema` is strict | `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:1903`, built with `strictObject` ⇒ authoring these keys is a **parse failure**, resolving the card's own "strips or rejects" hedge to *rejects* |
| no authorable virtual-scroll switch anywhere | `virtualScroll` 0 hits across the UI authorable surface, consistent with the retired-key entries above |
| `pagination` is the right redirect | `view.zod.ts:1366`, and spec's own retirement guidance at `:1515` says *"large datasets page via `pagination`"* — the doc uses spec's own words |
| both doc links resolve | `widget-contract.mdx:251` is a real `## Performance` anchor; `content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx` exists. `Check Documentation Links` independently green |
| scope | 1 file, +23/−40, docs-only, `skip-changeset` applied. No schema widened — correct, that would be a `domain:spec` change |
| CI | 21 check runs, **zero failures**; `TypeScript Type Check` still `in_progress` at review time and will be confirmed before this is flipped ready |

### Residual work, filed as #8306

The dispatch order asked the dev to measure the **tab-level** `lazy` (~`:484`/`:488`) separately rather than fold it into the section fix. Its body shows it measured the surface, but it died before acting or reporting, so I completed that measurement myself: `lazy` has **0** exact-key hits across all 1049 UI authorable keys, and tab schemas *are* represented (`ui/ViewTab` declares `filter`/`icon`/`isDefault`/`label`/`name`/`order`/`pinned`/`view`/`visible`; `ui/PageTabsProps` its own set) — so the zero is real, not an artifact of tabs being missing from the surface.

⇒ **The tab-level `lazy` is phantom too**, and the page is now internally inconsistent: its new `## Performance` section states that no section declares `lazy`, while an earlier passage still demonstrates `lazy` as working tab syntax. Filed as **#8306**, unassigned and ungraded — routing is triage's.

⚠️ Worth recording how that nearly went wrong: a bare `grep lazy packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` returns several hits, and **every one is the `lazySchema` import helper** — an unrelated identifier that would have produced the opposite conclusion. Position, not count.

`Fixes #8251` stands: the card was scoped to the section family and that family is fully addressed.
